name: Kaelen
description: Young man with silver spiky hair, sharp emerald eyes, wearing a tattered dark indigo cloak over tactical gear, glowing blue runes on his forearm.
distinguishing_marks: silver spiky hair, emerald eyes, tattered dark indigo hooded cloak over tactical gear, glowing blue runes on the forearm
personality: Curious and brave; hesitant at first, then determined and defiant when cornered. Earnest, short lines ('Is this the source of the ancients?', 'Come and face me then, monster!').
voice_notes: Dialogue appears only as speech bubbles. Narration (a separate narrator, never Kaelen) uses the channel voice en-US-AvaNeural. Keep Kaelen's lines short and emotional, never sarcastic.

references.use: full body, cloak and outfit (reference for costume)
